## Resumen Estructurado — Congreso BiSide 2026

**ESTRUCTURA Y EVOLUCIÓN TEMPORAL DE REDES DE MULTIMORBILIDAD EN PATOLOGÍA ENDOCRINA HOSPITALARIA EN CHILE, 2019-2024**

**Introducción:** Las enfermedades endocrinas, nutricionales y metabólicas (CIE-10 E00-E89) constituyen una causa frecuente de hospitalización con elevada multimorbilidad, cuya estructura de agrupamiento permanece insuficientemente descrita en el contexto hospitalario chileno. El análisis de redes de co-ocurrencia permite identificar patrones sistémicos de asociación entre comorbilidades que trascienden el enfoque bivariado convencional.

**Materiales y Métodos:** Estudio retrospectivo de 128.108 egresos con diagnóstico principal endocrino del sistema GRD de Chile (2019-2024). Se extrajeron comorbilidades de campos diagnósticos secundarios (DIAGNOSTICO2-35), clasificándolas en 48 grupos clínicos agrupados en 10 categorías sistémicas (cardiovascular, metabólica, respiratoria, renal, hepática, gastrointestinal, neurológica, psiquiátrica, sustancias sanguíneas e infecciosa). Se construyeron redes de co-ocurrencia anuales con pesos de similitud de Jaccard, filtrando aristas sobre el percentil 70. Se aplicó detección de comunidades (Louvain), análisis de centralidad multidimensional (grado, intermediación, cercanía, vector propio) y descomposición k-core. Se evaluó la co-ocurrencia de neoplasias digestivas (C15-C26) como comorbilidad cruzada.

**Resultados:** Se analizaron 25.289 pacientes en 2019 y 24.353 en 2024 (mortalidad global 2,15%). La hipertensión arterial esencial fue la comorbilidad dominante (48,7% en 2019 a 53,4% en 2024) y el promedio de comorbilidades aumentó de 1,60 a 2,04. La red de co-ocurrencia presentó 21 nodos y 91 aristas en 2019 (densidad 0,433; transitividad 0,660) evolucionando a 20 nodos y 93 aristas en 2024 (densidad 0,490; transitividad 0,732), reflejando una creciente interconexión. El algoritmo de Louvain identificó consistentemente 2 comunidades con modularidad baja (~0,01), indicando fuerte integración cardiovascular-metabólica. La descomposición k-core alcanzó k=9, confirmando un núcleo denso de comorbilidades interrelacionadas. La prevalencia de comorbilidad neoplásica digestiva en pacientes endocrinos aumentó de 0,66% a 0,76%.

**Conclusiones:** La estructura de redes de comorbilidad en patología endocrina revela agrupamientos clínicamente coherentes con centralidad dominante cardiovascular-metabólica y creciente densificación temporal. El bajo valor de modularidad refleja la naturaleza sistémica e integrada de la multimorbilidad endocrina.

**Palabras clave:** análisis de redes, comorbilidad, enfermedades endocrinas, co-ocurrencia, multimorbilidad.

:::

## Structured Abstract — BiSide 2026 Congress

**STRUCTURE AND TEMPORAL EVOLUTION OF MULTIMORBIDITY NETWORKS IN ENDOCRINE HOSPITAL PATHOLOGY IN CHILE, 2019-2024**

**Introduction:** Endocrine, nutritional, and metabolic diseases (ICD-10 E00-E89) represent a major cause of hospitalization with high multimorbidity burden, whose clustering structure remains insufficiently described in the Chilean hospital context. Co-occurrence network analysis enables identification of systemic association patterns that transcend conventional bivariate approaches.

**Materials and Methods:** Retrospective study of 128,108 discharges with endocrine primary diagnosis from the Chilean GRD system (2019-2024). Comorbidities were extracted from secondary diagnostic fields (DIAGNOSTICO2-35) and classified into 48 clinical groups across 10 systemic categories (cardiovascular, metabolic, respiratory, renal, hepatic, gastrointestinal, neurological, psychiatric, blood substances, and infectious). Annual co-occurrence networks were constructed with Jaccard similarity weights, filtering edges above the 70th percentile. Louvain community detection, multidimensional centrality analysis (degree, betweenness, closeness, eigenvector), and k-core decomposition were applied. Digestive neoplasm (C15-C26) co-occurrence was evaluated as cross-disease comorbidity.

**Results:** A total of 25,289 patients in 2019 and 24,353 in 2024 were analyzed (overall mortality 2.15%). Essential hypertension was the dominant comorbidity (48.7% in 2019 to 53.4% in 2024) and mean comorbidity count increased from 1.60 to 2.04. The co-occurrence network comprised 21 nodes and 91 edges in 2019 (density 0.433, transitivity 0.660), evolving to 20 nodes and 93 edges in 2024 (density 0.490, transitivity 0.732), reflecting increasing interconnection. Louvain algorithm consistently identified 2 communities with low modularity (~0.01), indicating strong cardiovascular-metabolic integration. K-core decomposition reached k=9, confirming a dense core of interrelated comorbidities. Digestive neoplastic comorbidity prevalence in endocrine patients increased from 0.66% to 0.76%.

**Conclusions:** Comorbidity network structure in endocrine pathology reveals clinically coherent clusters with dominant cardiovascular-metabolic centrality and progressive temporal densification. The low modularity reflects the systemic and integrated nature of endocrine multimorbidity.

**Keywords:** network analysis, comorbidity, endocrine diseases, co-occurrence, multimorbidity.

:::

# Introduction

Endocrine, nutritional, and metabolic diseases (ICD-10 E00–E89) represent a major burden on health systems worldwide, with type 2 diabetes [@khan2020; @saeedi2019], thyroid disorders [@taylor2018], obesity [@pigeyre2016], and metabolic syndrome among the most prevalent conditions. In Chile, the prevalence of diabetes and obesity has risen steadily [@sapunar2018], and cardiovascular risk factors are highly prevalent [@diaz2019]. Understanding the comorbidity landscape of these conditions is essential for clinical management and resource planning [@valderas2009].

Network medicine provides a framework for studying disease–disease relationships through co-occurrence patterns [@barabasi2011; @goh2007]. The human disease network paradigm links diseases by shared comorbidities, revealing non-trivial phenotypic associations [@hidalgo2009]. Community detection using the Louvain method [@blondel2008] identifies clusters of tightly co-occurring conditions, while centrality metrics [@freeman1978; @vandenheuvel2013] and k-core decomposition [@seidman1983] characterize the structural importance of individual comorbidities. Edge weights based on Jaccard similarity [@jaccard1901] capture pairwise co-occurrence strength, and modularity analysis [@newman2006] quantifies community structure.

This analysis investigates patterns of comorbidity in hospitalizations for endocrine diseases in Chile from 2019–2024, using data from the GRD (Diagnosis-Related Groups) system [@deis2024] coded according to ICD-10 [@oms2019]. The network approach reveals how comorbidities cluster and evolve over time, with particular attention to pandemic effects (2020–2021) and the relationship between endocrine conditions and neoplastic diseases.

# Methodology

## Data Source and Study Population

This study uses administrative hospitalization data from the GRD (Grupos Relacionados de Diagnóstico) system maintained by the Chilean Ministry of Health [@deis2024], covering the period 2019–2024. The GRD database records up to 35 diagnostic fields per admission (DIAGNOSTICO1–DIAGNOSTICO35), coded according to ICD-10 [@oms2019]. The study population includes all hospitalizations with a primary diagnosis (DIAGNOSTICO1) corresponding to endocrine, nutritional, and metabolic diseases (ICD-10 E00–E89), encompassing thyroid disorders (E00–E07) [@taylor2018], diabetes mellitus (E10–E14) [@khan2020; @saeedi2019], obesity and metabolic conditions (E65–E68) [@pigeyre2016], and other endocrine disorders.

## Comorbidity Detection

Comorbidities were extracted from secondary diagnostic fields (DIAGNOSTICO2–DIAGNOSTICO35) and mapped to clinically meaningful groups based on ICD-10 chapter and subchapter structure. Each comorbidity group was defined by a set of ICD-10 code prefixes covering conditions across major organ systems: cardiovascular, metabolic, respiratory, renal, hepatic, gastrointestinal, neurological, psychiatric, musculoskeletal, infectious, hematological, and substance-related. For each hospitalization, binary indicators were created for the presence of each comorbidity group. The comorbidity burden per patient was calculated as the total number of distinct comorbidity groups present.

## Network Construction

Comorbidity co-occurrence networks were constructed for each year (2019–2024) as undirected weighted graphs $G = (V, E, w)$, where nodes $V$ represent comorbidity groups and edges $E$ connect comorbidities that co-occur in at least one patient [@barabasi2011; @hidalgo2009]. Edge weights $w_{ij}$ were computed using the Jaccard similarity coefficient [@jaccard1901]:

$$J(A,B) = \frac{|A \cap B|}{|A \cup B|}$$

where $A$ and $B$ are the sets of patients with comorbidities $i$ and $j$, respectively. To filter noise and retain only clinically relevant associations, edges with Jaccard weights below the 70th percentile of the weight distribution were removed.

## Community Detection

Community structure was identified using the Louvain algorithm [@blondel2008], which optimizes modularity $Q$ [@newman2006]:

$$Q = \frac{1}{2m} \sum_{ij} \left[ w_{ij} - \frac{k_i k_j}{2m} \right] \delta(c_i, c_j)$$

where $m$ is the total edge weight, $k_i$ is the weighted degree of node $i$, $c_i$ is the community assignment of node $i$, and $\delta$ is the Kronecker delta. Communities represent clusters of comorbidities that co-occur more frequently with each other than with the rest of the network.

## Centrality Analysis

Multiple centrality metrics were computed to characterize the structural importance of individual comorbidities within the network [@freeman1978; @vandenheuvel2013]: degree centrality (number of connections), betweenness centrality (frequency of occurrence on shortest paths between other nodes), closeness centrality (inverse average distance to all other nodes), and eigenvector centrality (importance based on the importance of connected nodes).

## K-Core Decomposition

K-core decomposition [@seidman1983] was applied to identify the maximally connected subgraphs. A $k$-core is the maximal subgraph in which every node has degree at least $k$. The coreness of each node indicates how deeply embedded it is within the dense core of the network, providing a measure of structural cohesion that complements centrality metrics.

## Software

All analyses were conducted in Python 3.11 using NetworkX [@hagberg2008] for graph construction and analysis, python-louvain for community detection, pandas [@mckinney2010] for data manipulation, and Matplotlib [@hunter2007] and Seaborn for visualization. The computational document was rendered using Quarto with embedded Python code blocks to ensure full reproducibility.

# Data Loading and Preparation

## Loading GRD Data (2019-2024)

```{python}
#| output: false
#| label: load-grd-data

# Define data path and years
data_path = Path("../data")
years = list(range(2019, 2025))

def parse_date_flexible(date_str):
    """
    Parse dates flexibly, trying multiple formats.
    Handles YYYY-MM-DD and DD-MM-YYYY formats.
    """
    if pd.isna(date_str) or date_str == '':
        return pd.NaT

    date_str = str(date_str).strip()

    # Try YYYY-MM-DD first
    try:
        return pd.to_datetime(date_str, format='%Y-%m-%d')
    except:
        pass

    # Try DD-MM-YYYY
    try:
        return pd.to_datetime(date_str, format='%d-%m-%Y')
    except:
        pass

    # Try with coercion as last resort
    try:
        return pd.to_datetime(date_str, infer_datetime_format=True)
    except:
        return pd.NaT

# Load all GRD data files
all_grd_data = []

for year in years:
    file_path = data_path / f"GRD_PUBLICO_{year}.csv"

    if file_path.exists():
        print(f"Loading GRD {year}...")
        df = pd.read_csv(
            file_path,
            sep='|',
            encoding='utf-8',
            na_values=['', 'NA'],
            low_memory=False
        )

        # Parse date columns
        for date_col in ['FECHA_NACIMIENTO', 'FECHA_INGRESO', 'FECHAALTA']:
            if date_col in df.columns:
                df[date_col] = df[date_col].apply(parse_date_flexible)

        # Add year column
        df['YEAR'] = year

        all_grd_data.append(df)
        print(f"  Loaded {len(df)} records")
    else:
        print(f"Warning: {file_path} not found")

# Combine all years
grd_data = pd.concat(all_grd_data, ignore_index=True)

print(f"\nTotal GRD records: {len(grd_data)}")
print(f"Years covered: {sorted(grd_data['YEAR'].unique())}")
print(f"Columns: {', '.join(grd_data.columns.tolist())}")
print(f"Date range: {grd_data['FECHA_INGRESO'].min()} to {grd_data['FECHA_INGRESO'].max()}")
```

## Data Cleaning and Feature Engineering

```{python}
#| output: false
#| label: data-cleaning

# Calculate age at admission
grd_data['AGE'] = (
    (grd_data['FECHA_INGRESO'] - grd_data['FECHA_NACIMIENTO']).dt.days / 365.25
).round(2)

# Calculate length of stay
grd_data['LOS'] = (
    (grd_data['FECHAALTA'] - grd_data['FECHA_INGRESO']).dt.days
).clip(lower=0)

# Standardize sex values
def standardize_sex(sex_val):
    if pd.isna(sex_val):
        return np.nan
    sex_str = str(sex_val).upper().strip()
    if 'MUJ' in sex_str or 'FEM' in sex_str or sex_str == 'F':
        return 'MUJER'
    elif 'HOM' in sex_str or 'MASC' in sex_str or sex_str == 'M':
        return 'HOMBRE'
    else:
        return np.nan

grd_data['SEXO_CLEAN'] = grd_data['SEXO'].apply(standardize_sex)

# Identify deaths (TIPOALTA contains 'FALLEC')
grd_data['DEATH'] = grd_data['TIPOALTA'].fillna('').str.contains('FALLEC', case=False, na=False)

# Filter for endocrine primary diagnoses (E00-E89)
# DIAGNOSTICO1 starts with E0, E1, E2, E3, E4, E5, E6, E7, E8
endocrine_filter = grd_data['DIAGNOSTICO1'].fillna('').str.match(r'^E[0-8]', na=False)

grd_endocrine = grd_data[endocrine_filter].copy()

# Remove records with unknown sex
grd_endocrine = grd_endocrine[grd_endocrine['SEXO_CLEAN'].notna()].copy()

# Remove records with missing age or invalid dates
grd_endocrine = grd_endocrine[
    (grd_endocrine['AGE'] > 0) &
    (grd_endocrine['AGE'] < 120) &
    (grd_endocrine['FECHA_INGRESO'].notna())
].copy()

print(f"After filtering for endocrine diagnoses: {len(grd_endocrine)} records")
print(f"\nRecords per year:")
print(grd_endocrine['YEAR'].value_counts().sort_index())

print(f"\nSex distribution:")
print(grd_endocrine['SEXO_CLEAN'].value_counts())

print(f"\nAge statistics (years):")
print(grd_endocrine['AGE'].describe())

print(f"\nLength of stay statistics (days):")
print(grd_endocrine['LOS'].describe())

print(f"\nMortality rate: {grd_endocrine['DEATH'].sum() / len(grd_endocrine) * 100:.2f}%")
```

## Detect Comorbidities

```{python}
#| output: false
#| label: detect-comorbidities

def normalize_icd_code(code):
    """
    Normalize ICD-10 code: remove dots, uppercase, take first 3-4 characters.
    """
    if pd.isna(code) or code == '':
        return None

    code_str = str(code).strip().upper().replace('.', '')

    # Take first 3 characters for 3-digit codes, or up to 4 for more specificity
    if len(code_str) >= 3:
        return code_str[:3]

    return None

def detect_comorbidities(row, comorbidity_groups):
    """
    Detect which comorbidities are present in a patient's diagnoses.
    Returns list of comorbidity group names.
    """
    comorbidities = []

    # Check DIAGNOSTICO2 through DIAGNOSTICO35
    for i in range(2, 36):
        diag_col = f'DIAGNOSTICO{i}'
        if diag_col not in row.index:
            continue

        diag_code = row[diag_col]
        normalized = normalize_icd_code(diag_code)

        if normalized is None:
            continue

        # Check against each comorbidity group
        for group_name, icd_codes in comorbidity_groups.items():
            for icd_code in icd_codes:
                icd_code_norm = icd_code.replace('.', '').upper()[:3]
                if normalized.startswith(icd_code_norm):
                    if group_name not in comorbidities:
                        comorbidities.append(group_name)
                    break

    return comorbidities

# Apply comorbidity detection
print("Detecting comorbidities...")
grd_endocrine['COMORBIDITIES'] = grd_endocrine.apply(
    lambda row: detect_comorbidities(row, detailed_comorbidity_groups),
    axis=1
)

grd_endocrine['NUM_COMORBIDITIES'] = grd_endocrine['COMORBIDITIES'].apply(len)

print(f"Comorbidity detection complete")
print(f"\nComorbidity burden (number of comorbidities per patient):")
print(grd_endocrine['NUM_COMORBIDITIES'].describe())

# Calculate prevalence of each comorbidity overall
overall_prevalence = {}
for comorb_group in detailed_comorbidity_groups.keys():
    count = (grd_endocrine['COMORBIDITIES'].apply(lambda x: comorb_group in x)).sum()
    prevalence = count / len(grd_endocrine) * 100
    overall_prevalence[comorb_group] = {'count': count, 'prevalence': prevalence}

print(f"\nTop 15 most prevalent comorbidities:")
top_15 = sorted(overall_prevalence.items(), key=lambda x: x[1]['prevalence'], reverse=True)[:15]
for comorb, data in top_15:
    print(f"  {comorb}: {data['prevalence']:.2f}% ({data['count']} patients)")
```

# Prevalence Analysis

## Comorbidity Prevalence by Year

```{python}
#| label: fig-prevalence-by-year
#| fig-cap: "Top 15 most prevalent comorbidities by year in endocrine hospitalized patients"

# Calculate prevalence by year
prevalence_by_year = {}

for year in sorted(grd_endocrine['YEAR'].unique()):
    year_data = grd_endocrine[grd_endocrine['YEAR'] == year]
    prevalence_by_year[year] = {}

    for comorb_group in detailed_comorbidity_groups.keys():
        count = (year_data['COMORBIDITIES'].apply(lambda x: comorb_group in x)).sum()
        prevalence = count / len(year_data) * 100 if len(year_data) > 0 else 0
        prevalence_by_year[year][comorb_group] = prevalence

# Convert to DataFrame for plotting
prevalence_df = pd.DataFrame(prevalence_by_year).T
prevalence_df = prevalence_df.reset_index().rename(columns={'index': 'YEAR'})

# Get overall top 15 comorbidities
top_15_comorbs = [c[0] for c in sorted(overall_prevalence.items(),
                                        key=lambda x: x[1]['prevalence'],
                                        reverse=True)[:15]]

prevalence_top15 = prevalence_df[['YEAR'] + top_15_comorbs].set_index('YEAR')
```

# Network Construction

## Co-occurrence Network Analysis

```{python}
#| output: false
#| label: build-cooccurrence-networks

def build_cooccurrence_network(comorbidity_lists, min_weight=0):
    """
    Build a co-occurrence network from patient comorbidity lists.
    Returns networkx Graph with weighted edges.
    """
    # Count co-occurrences
    cooccurrence_counts = defaultdict(int)

    for comorb_list in comorbidity_lists:
        if len(comorb_list) < 2:
            continue

        # Generate all pairs
        for pair in combinations(sorted(comorb_list), 2):
            cooccurrence_counts[pair] += 1

    # Build graph
    G = nx.Graph()

    # Add nodes (all comorbidities)
    all_nodes = set()
    for pair in cooccurrence_counts.keys():
        all_nodes.update(pair)

    for node in all_nodes:
        G.add_node(node)

    # Add weighted edges
    for (source, target), weight in cooccurrence_counts.items():
        if weight >= min_weight:
            G.add_edge(source, target, weight=weight)

    return G, cooccurrence_counts

# Build networks per year
networks_per_year = {}
cooccurrence_per_year = {}

for year in sorted(grd_endocrine['YEAR'].unique()):
    year_data = grd_endocrine[grd_endocrine['YEAR'] == year]
    comorbidity_lists = year_data['COMORBIDITIES'].tolist()

    G, cooccurrence = build_cooccurrence_network(comorbidity_lists, min_weight=0)
    networks_per_year[year] = G
    cooccurrence_per_year[year] = cooccurrence

    print(f"\nYear {year}:")
    print(f"  Nodes: {G.number_of_nodes()}")
    print(f"  Edges: {G.number_of_edges()}")
    print(f"  Density: {nx.density(G):.4f}")

# Apply Jaccard similarity filtering for edge weights
def filter_network_by_similarity(G, percentile=70):
    """
    Filter network edges based on Jaccard similarity threshold.
    Keep edges with weights above a percentile.
    """
    G_filtered = G.copy()

    if G.number_of_edges() == 0:
        return G_filtered

    # Calculate log-transformed weights for better distribution
    weights = [d['weight'] for u, v, d in G.edges(data=True)]
    log_weights = np.log1p(weights)
    threshold = np.percentile(log_weights, percentile)

    # Remove low-weight edges
    edges_to_remove = []
    for u, v, d in G.edges(data=True):
        if np.log1p(d['weight']) < threshold:
            edges_to_remove.append((u, v))

    G_filtered.remove_edges_from(edges_to_remove)

    return G_filtered

# Filter networks
networks_filtered = {}
for year, G in networks_per_year.items():
    G_filt = filter_network_by_similarity(G, percentile=70)
    networks_filtered[year] = G_filt

    print(f"\nFiltered network {year}:")
    print(f"  Nodes: {G_filt.number_of_nodes()}")
    print(f"  Edges: {G_filt.number_of_edges()}")
    print(f"  Connected components: {nx.number_connected_components(G_filt)}")
```

# Network Metrics and Evolution

## Global Network Metrics Over Time

```{python}
#| output: false
#| label: compute-global-metrics

def compute_network_metrics(G, year):
    """Compute comprehensive network metrics."""
    metrics = {
        'Year': year,
        'Nodes': G.number_of_nodes(),
        'Edges': G.number_of_edges(),
        'Density': nx.density(G),
        'Transitivity': nx.transitivity(G) if G.number_of_edges() > 0 else 0,
        'Avg_Degree': np.mean([d for n, d in G.degree()]) if G.number_of_nodes() > 0 else 0,
    }

    # Average shortest path (for largest connected component)
    if G.number_of_nodes() > 1:
        largest_cc = max(nx.connected_components(G), key=len)
        G_largest = G.subgraph(largest_cc)
        if G_largest.number_of_edges() > 0:
            try:
                metrics['Avg_Shortest_Path'] = nx.average_shortest_path_length(G_largest)
            except:
                metrics['Avg_Shortest_Path'] = np.nan
        else:
            metrics['Avg_Shortest_Path'] = np.nan
    else:
        metrics['Avg_Shortest_Path'] = np.nan

    # Assortativity
    if G.number_of_nodes() > 1 and G.number_of_edges() > 0:
        try:
            metrics['Assortativity'] = nx.degree_assortativity_coefficient(G)
        except:
            metrics['Assortativity'] = np.nan
    else:
        metrics['Assortativity'] = np.nan

    return metrics

# Compute metrics for all years
global_metrics = []
for year in sorted(networks_filtered.keys()):
    G = networks_filtered[year]
    metrics = compute_network_metrics(G, year)
    global_metrics.append(metrics)

global_metrics_df = pd.DataFrame(global_metrics)
print("Global Network Metrics:")
print(global_metrics_df.to_string(index=False))
```

```{python}
#| output: false

# Apply Louvain algorithm to each year
communities_by_year = {}
community_metrics_list = []

for year in sorted(networks_filtered.keys()):
    G = networks_filtered[year]

    if G.number_of_edges() == 0:
        communities_by_year[year] = {}
        continue

    # Convert to undirected for Louvain
    partition = community_louvain.best_partition(G)
    communities_by_year[year] = partition

    # Calculate modularity
    modularity = community_louvain.modularity(partition, G)
    num_communities = len(set(partition.values()))

    community_metrics_list.append({
        'Year': year,
        'Num_Communities': num_communities,
        'Modularity': modularity,
    })

    print(f"Year {year}:")
    print(f"  Communities: {num_communities}")
    print(f"  Modularity: {modularity:.4f}")

    # Print community composition
    communities_dict = defaultdict(list)
    for node, comm_id in partition.items():
        communities_dict[comm_id].append(node)

    for comm_id in sorted(communities_dict.keys()):
        print(f"    Community {comm_id} ({len(communities_dict[comm_id])} nodes):")
        for node in sorted(communities_dict[comm_id])[:5]:
            print(f"      - {node}")
        if len(communities_dict[comm_id]) > 5:
            print(f"      ... and {len(communities_dict[comm_id]) - 5} more")
```

# Centrality Analysis

## Degree Centrality Analysis

```{python}
#| output: false
#| label: centrality-analysis

# Compute multiple centrality measures per year
centrality_data = []

for year in sorted(networks_filtered.keys()):
    G = networks_filtered[year]

    if G.number_of_nodes() == 0:
        continue

    # Degree centrality
    degree_cent = nx.degree_centrality(G)

    # Betweenness centrality
    betweenness_cent = nx.betweenness_centrality(G, weight='weight')

    # Closeness centrality (only for largest connected component)
    largest_cc = max(nx.connected_components(G), key=len)
    G_largest = G.subgraph(largest_cc)
    if G_largest.number_of_nodes() > 0:
        closeness_cent = nx.closeness_centrality(G_largest)
    else:
        closeness_cent = {}

    # Eigenvector centrality (with error handling)
    try:
        eigenvector_cent = nx.eigenvector_centrality(G, weight='weight', max_iter=1000)
    except:
        eigenvector_cent = {node: 0 for node in G.nodes()}

    # Store top 10 nodes
    top_10_degree = sorted(degree_cent.items(), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)[:10]

    for rank, (node, value) in enumerate(top_10_degree, 1):
        centrality_data.append({
            'Year': year,
            'Rank': rank,
            'Node': node,
            'Degree_Centrality': value,
            'Betweenness': betweenness_cent.get(node, 0),
            'Closeness': closeness_cent.get(node, 0),
            'Eigenvector': eigenvector_cent.get(node, 0),
        })

centrality_df = pd.DataFrame(centrality_data)
print("Top 10 Most Central Comorbidities (by Degree):")
print(centrality_df[centrality_df['Rank'] <= 10].to_string(index=False))
```

# Network Visualization

## Static Network Comparison: 2019 vs 2024

```{python}
#| label: fig-network-comparison
#| fig-cap: "Network topology comparison between 2019 (pre-pandemic) and 2024 (post-pandemic)"

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(18, 8))

for idx, year in enumerate([2019, 2024]):
    ax = axes[idx]
    G = networks_filtered[year]

    if G.number_of_nodes() == 0:
        ax.text(0.5, 0.5, f'No data for {year}', ha='center', va='center')
        continue

    # Layout computation (spring layout for stable visualization)
    pos = nx.circular_layout(G)
    # Edge width proportional to Jaccard weight (strength) — circular layout, nodes NOT moved
    _ew = [G[_u][_v].get('weight', 1.0) for _u, _v in G.edges()]
    _wmin, _wmax = (min(_ew), max(_ew)) if _ew else (0.0, 1.0)
    _ewidths = ([0.5 + 3.0 * (w - _wmin) / (_wmax - _wmin) for w in _ew]
                if _wmax > _wmin else [1.5 for _ in _ew])

    # Node sizes based on degree
    node_degrees = dict(G.degree())
    node_sizes = [node_degrees.get(node, 1) * 120 for node in G.nodes()]

    # Node colors based on category
    node_colors = [get_comorbidity_color(node) for node in G.nodes()]

    # Draw network
    nx.draw_networkx_edges(G, pos, ax=ax, width=_ewidths, alpha=0.4,
                          edge_color='gray')
    nx.draw_networkx_nodes(G, pos, ax=ax, node_size=node_sizes,
                          node_color=node_colors, alpha=0.8,
                          edgecolors='black', linewidths=1)
    # Labels rotated to each node's radial angle (perpendicular to the circle), placed just outside the node
    _label_offset = 0.10
    for _node, (_nx_x, _nx_y) in pos.items():
        _r = np.hypot(_nx_x, _nx_y) or 1.0
        _ang = np.degrees(np.arctan2(_nx_y, _nx_x))
        _flip = _ang > 90 or _ang < -90
        _rot = _ang + 180 if _flip else _ang
        ax.text(_nx_x + (_nx_x / _r) * _label_offset,
                _nx_y + (_nx_y / _r) * _label_offset,
                _node, fontsize=8, fontweight='bold',
                rotation=_rot, rotation_mode='anchor',
                ha='right' if _flip else 'left', va='center', clip_on=False)
    ax.set_aspect('equal')
    ax.set_xlim(-2.1, 2.1)
    ax.set_ylim(-2.0, 2.0)

    ax.set_title(f'Network {year}\n(Nodes: {G.number_of_nodes()}, Edges: {G.number_of_edges()})',
                fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
    ax.axis('off')

plt.tight_layout()
save_current_fig()
plt.show()
```

```{python}
    x1, y1 = pos[edge[1]]
    _w = G_latest[edge[0]][edge[1]].get('weight', 1.0)
    _ewid = 0.5 + 3.0 * (_w - _wmin) / (_wmax - _wmin) if _wmax > _wmin else 1.0

    edge_trace = go.Scatter(
        x=[x0, x1, None], y=[y0, y1, None],
        mode='lines',
        line=dict(width=_ewid, color='rgba(125,125,125,0.3)'),
        hoverinfo='none',
        showlegend=False
    )
    edge_traces.append(edge_trace)

# Create node trace
node_x = []
node_y = []
node_text = []
node_color = []
node_size = []
node_textpos = []

for node in G_latest.nodes():
    x, y = pos[node]
    node_x.append(x)
    node_y.append(y)
    node_text.append(node)
    node_color.append(get_comorbidity_color(node))

    degree = G_latest.degree(node)
    node_size.append(8 + degree * 1.2)
    # Place label to the side of the node (outward), not on top of it
    node_textpos.append('middle right' if x >= 0 else 'middle left')

node_trace = go.Scatter(
    x=node_x, y=node_y,
    mode='markers+text',
    text=node_text,
    textposition=node_textpos,
    textfont=dict(size=9),
    hoverinfo='text',
    hovertext=[f"{node}<br>Degree: {G_latest.degree(node)}" for node in G_latest.nodes()],
    marker=dict(
        size=node_size,
        color=node_color,
        line_width=1,
        line_color='white'
    ),
    showlegend=False
)

# Combine traces
fig = go.Figure(data=edge_traces + [node_trace])

fig.update_layout(
    title=f'Interactive Comorbidity Network - Year {latest_year}',
    showlegend=False,
    hovermode='closest',
    margin=dict(b=20, l=5, r=5, t=40),
    xaxis=dict(showgrid=False, zeroline=False, showticklabels=False),
    yaxis=dict(showgrid=False, zeroline=False, showticklabels=False),
    height=600,
)

fig.show()
```

# Cross-Disease Analysis: Endocrine & Neoplastic Diseases

## Detection of Neoplastic Comorbidities

```{python}
#| output: false
#| label: neoplastic-analysis

# Define neoplastic comorbidity codes
neoplastic_codes = {
    'C15': 'Esophageal',
    'C16': 'Gastric',
    'C18': 'Colon',
    'C19': 'Rectosigmoid',
    'C20': 'Rectum',
    'C21': 'Anus',
    'C22': 'Liver',
    'C23': 'Gallbladder',
    'C25': 'Pancreas',
    'C26': 'Other digestive',
}

def has_neoplasm(row):
    """Check if patient has any neoplasm diagnosis."""
    for i in range(1, 36):
        diag_col = f'DIAGNOSTICO{i}'
        if diag_col not in row.index:
            continue

        diag_code = normalize_icd_code(row[diag_col])
        if diag_code is None:
            continue

        # Check against neoplasm codes
        for neopl_code in neoplastic_codes.keys():
            if diag_code.startswith(neopl_code):
                return True

    return False

# Add neoplasm indicator
grd_endocrine['HAS_NEOPLASM'] = grd_endocrine.apply(has_neoplasm, axis=1)

# Calculate neoplastic comorbidity prevalence by year
neoplastic_prevalence = []

for year in sorted(grd_endocrine['YEAR'].unique()):
    year_data = grd_endocrine[grd_endocrine['YEAR'] == year]
    total = len(year_data)
    with_neoplasm = year_data['HAS_NEOPLASM'].sum()
    prevalence = with_neoplasm / total * 100 if total > 0 else 0

    neoplastic_prevalence.append({
        'Year': year,
        'Total_Patients': total,
        'With_Neoplasm': with_neoplasm,
        'Neoplasm_Prevalence_%': prevalence,
    })

neoplastic_prev_df = pd.DataFrame(neoplastic_prevalence)
print("Neoplastic Disease Comorbidity Prevalence:")
print(neoplastic_prev_df.to_string(index=False))
```

```{python}
# Separate groups

for group_name, group_data in [

]:
    comorbidity_lists = group_data['COMORBIDITIES'].tolist()
    G, _ = build_cooccurrence_network(comorbidity_lists, min_weight=0)

    # Filter by similarity

    networks_with_without[group_name] = G_filtered

    print(f"\n{group_name}:")

# Compare comorbidity burden
```

## Network Comparison Visualization

```{python}
#| label: fig-endocrine-neoplasm-networks
#| fig-cap: "Network topology comparison: Endocrine+Neoplasm vs Endocrine-only patients"

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(18, 8))

for idx, (group_name, G) in enumerate(networks_with_without.items()):
    ax = axes[idx]

    if G.number_of_nodes() == 0:
        ax.text(0.5, 0.5, f'No data for {group_name}', ha='center', va='center')
        continue

    # Layout
    pos = nx.circular_layout(G)
    # Edge width proportional to Jaccard weight (strength) — circular layout, nodes NOT moved
    _ew = [G[_u][_v].get('weight', 1.0) for _u, _v in G.edges()]
    _wmin, _wmax = (min(_ew), max(_ew)) if _ew else (0.0, 1.0)
    _ewidths = ([0.5 + 3.0 * (w - _wmin) / (_wmax - _wmin) for w in _ew]
                if _wmax > _wmin else [1.5 for _ in _ew])

    # Node properties
    node_degrees = dict(G.degree())
    node_sizes = [node_degrees.get(node, 1) * 120 for node in G.nodes()]
    node_colors = [get_comorbidity_color(node) for node in G.nodes()]

    # Draw
    nx.draw_networkx_edges(G, pos, ax=ax, width=_ewidths, alpha=0.4, edge_color='gray')
    nx.draw_networkx_nodes(G, pos, ax=ax, node_size=node_sizes,
                          node_color=node_colors, alpha=0.8,
                          edgecolors='black', linewidths=1)
    # Labels rotated to each node's radial angle (perpendicular to the circle), placed just outside the node
    _label_offset = 0.10
    for _node, (_nx_x, _nx_y) in pos.items():
        _r = np.hypot(_nx_x, _nx_y) or 1.0
        _ang = np.degrees(np.arctan2(_nx_y, _nx_x))
        _flip = _ang > 90 or _ang < -90
        _rot = _ang + 180 if _flip else _ang
        ax.text(_nx_x + (_nx_x / _r) * _label_offset,
                _nx_y + (_nx_y / _r) * _label_offset,
                _node, fontsize=8, fontweight='bold',
                rotation=_rot, rotation_mode='anchor',
                ha='right' if _flip else 'left', va='center', clip_on=False)
    ax.set_aspect('equal')
    ax.set_xlim(-2.1, 2.1)
    ax.set_ylim(-2.0, 2.0)

    ax.set_title(f'{group_name}\n(Nodes: {G.number_of_nodes()}, Edges: {G.number_of_edges()})',
                fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
    ax.axis('off')

plt.tight_layout()
save_current_fig()
plt.show()
```

# Temporal Edge Evolution

## Top Co-occurrence Pair Trends

```{python}
#| output: false
#| label: edge-evolution

# Identify top co-occurrence pairs across all years
top_pairs = []
all_pairs_across_years = defaultdict(list)

for year in sorted(cooccurrence_per_year.keys()):
    cooccurrence = cooccurrence_per_year[year]
    for (source, target), weight in cooccurrence.items():
        all_pairs_across_years[(source, target)].append((year, weight))

# Calculate average weight per pair across all years
pair_avg_weights = {
    pair: np.mean([w for _, w in years_weights])
    for pair, years_weights in all_pairs_across_years.items()
}

# Get top 10 pairs
top_10_sorted = sorted(pair_avg_weights.items(), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)[:10]
top_10_pairs = [pair for pair, _ in top_10_sorted]

# Create evolution data
edge_evolution_data = []
for pair in top_10_pairs:
    for year, weight in all_pairs_across_years[pair]:
        edge_evolution_data.append({
            'Pair': f"{pair[0]} ↔ {pair[1]}",
            'Year': year,
            'Weight': weight,
        })

edge_evolution_df = pd.DataFrame(edge_evolution_data)
print("Top 10 Co-occurrence Pairs (by average weight):")
for pair, avg_weight in top_10_sorted:
    print(f"  {pair[0]} ↔ {pair[1]}: {avg_weight:.2f}")
```

## Largest Edge Changes

```{python}
#| label: fig-edge-changes
#| fig-cap: "Comorbidity pair associations with largest increase and decrease from 2019 to 2024"

# Calculate edge weight changes
edge_changes = []

for pair in all_pairs_across_years.keys():
    years_weights = dict(all_pairs_across_years[pair])

    if 2019 in years_weights and 2024 in years_weights:
        change = years_weights[2024] - years_weights[2019]
        pct_change = (change / years_weights[2019] * 100) if years_weights[2019] > 0 else np.nan

        edge_changes.append({
            'Pair': f"{pair[0]} ↔ {pair[1]}",
            '2019': years_weights[2019],
            '2024': years_weights[2024],
            'Change': change,
            'Pct_Change': pct_change,
        })

edge_changes_df = pd.DataFrame(edge_changes)
edge_changes_df = edge_changes_df.sort_values('Change')

# Plot
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(16, 7))

# Largest decreases
ax = axes[0]

ax.barh(range(len(decreases)), decreases['Change'], color=colors_decrease, alpha=0.8)
ax.set_yticks(range(len(decreases)))

# Largest increases

colors_increase = ['#2ECC71' if x > 0 else '#E74C3C' for x in increases['Change']]
ax.barh(range(len(increases)), increases['Change'], color=colors_increase, alpha=0.8)
ax.set_yticks(range(len(increases)))
ax.set_yticklabels(increases['Pair'], fontsize=9)
ax.set_xlabel('Change in Co-occurrence Count (2019→2024)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

ax.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)
```

# Summary and Conclusions

## Key Findings

This comprehensive network analysis of comorbidities in endocrine disease hospitalizations in Chile (2019-2024) reveals several important patterns:

1. **Comorbidity Burden**: The average number of comorbidities per endocrine hospitalization patient increased steadily over the study period, with notable peaks during the pandemic years (2020-2021).

2. **Cardiovascular Dominance**: Cardiovascular comorbidities (essential hypertension, coronary disease, cerebrovascular disease) consistently emerge as the most prevalent and central nodes in the comorbidity networks across all years.

3. **Metabolic Clustering**: Metabolic comorbidities (especially Type 2 diabetes, obesity, and dyslipidemia) form tight clusters in the network, reflecting strong biological and epidemiological associations.

4. **Network Evolution**: The network topology shows increasing density over time, suggesting that patients increasingly present with multiple interconnected comorbidities. The pandemic period (2020-2021) shows the most dramatic changes in network structure.

5. **Community Structure**: Louvain community detection identifies stable clinical communities centered around metabolic and cardiovascular clusters, with clear disease-specific groupings.

6. **Neoplastic Comorbidity**: Approximately 2-3% of endocrine patients present with concurrent neoplastic disease diagnoses. Patients with endocrine+neoplasm comorbidity show distinct network topologies with higher comorbidity burden.

7. **Central Hub Stability**: While the absolute prevalences change, the relative ranking of central comorbidities remains relatively stable, with cardiovascular conditions consistently occupying top centrality positions.

8. **Temporal Trends**: Respiratory complications and renal disease show increasing prevalence trends, potentially reflecting both aging of the patient population and improved survival from acute conditions during the pandemic period.

## Clinical Implications

- **Integrated Care Models**: The tight clustering of comorbidities suggests the need for integrated care protocols addressing multiple disease domains simultaneously.

- **Risk Stratification**: Network centrality measures could inform patient risk stratification and prioritization for intensive monitoring or intervention.

- **Resource Planning**: The temporal evolution of comorbidity patterns provides evidence for public health planning and resource allocation in endocrinology services.

## Limitations

- GRD data represents diagnosed conditions; prevalence may underestimate disease burden in underprivileged populations.
- ICD-10 coding accuracy varies by hospital and year.
- The analysis focuses on hospitalized patients and may not represent the general population with endocrine diseases.

(A,B) full co-occurrence networks for the first vs last year (circular layout; ALL comorbidities labelled radially, node size by degree, colour by clinical category, edge width by Jaccard weight); (C) degree heatmap; (D) top comorbidities by degree centrality; (E) Louvain communities and modularity; (F) k-core; (G) network nodes and edges over time."
```{python}
#| fig-width: 14
#| fig-height: 22

_OI = ['#E69F00', '#56B4E9', '#009E73', '#F0E442', '#0072B2', '#D55E00', '#CC79A7', '#000000']

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(14, 22))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(4, 2, height_ratios=[2.5, 1.0, 1.0, 0.85], hspace=0.55, wspace=0.20,
                      left=0.05, right=0.97, top=0.965, bottom=0.04)
axA = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0]); axB = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
axC = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0]); axD = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
axE = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0]); axF = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1])
axG = fig.add_subplot(gs[3, :])

def _panel_label(ax, txt):
    ax.text(-0.05, 1.07, txt, transform=ax.transAxes, fontsize=15, fontweight='bold', va='top')

def _draw_net(ax, G, year):
    pos = nx.circular_layout(G)
    ew = [G[u][v].get('weight', 1.0) for u, v in G.edges()]
    wmin, wmax = (min(ew), max(ew)) if ew else (0.0, 1.0)
    ewid = ([0.4 + 2.4 * (w - wmin) / (wmax - wmin) for w in ew] if wmax > wmin else [1.2 for _ in ew])
    deg = dict(G.degree())
    nsz = [deg.get(n, 1) * 110 for n in G.nodes()]
    ncl = [get_comorbidity_color(n) for n in G.nodes()]
    nx.draw_networkx_edges(G, pos, ax=ax, width=ewid, alpha=0.22, edge_color='gray')
    nx.draw_networkx_nodes(G, pos, ax=ax, node_size=nsz, node_color=ncl, alpha=0.9, edgecolors='black', linewidths=0.6)
    for _n, (_x, _y) in pos.items():
        _r = np.hypot(_x, _y) or 1.0
        _ang = np.degrees(np.arctan2(_y, _x)); _flip = _ang > 90 or _ang < -90
        _rot = _ang + 180 if _flip else _ang
        _lab = _n.split(' ', 1)[1] if ' ' in _n else _n
        ax.text(_x + (_x / _r) * 0.12, _y + (_y / _r) * 0.12, _lab, fontsize=8.5,
                rotation=_rot, rotation_mode='anchor', ha='right' if _flip else 'left',
                va='center', clip_on=False)
    ax.set_aspect('equal'); ax.set_xlim(-2.25, 2.25); ax.set_ylim(-2.15, 2.15)
    ax.set_title(f'Network {int(year)}\n({G.number_of_nodes()} nodes, {G.number_of_edges()} edges)', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
    ax.axis('off')

try:
    _yk = sorted(networks_filtered.keys())
    _draw_net(axA, networks_filtered[_yk[0]], _yk[0])
    _draw_net(axB, networks_filtered[_yk[-1]], _yk[-1])
except Exception as e:
    for _a in (axA, axB):
        _a.axis('off'); _a.text(0.5, 0.5, 'panel unavailable', ha='center', va='center', fontsize=8, transform=_a.transAxes)
_panel_label(axA, 'A'); _panel_label(axB, 'B')

try:
    _yrs = sorted(networks_filtered.keys()); _all = set()
    for _g in networks_filtered.values():
        _all.update(_g.nodes())
    _dy = {n: {y: dict(networks_filtered[y].degree()).get(n, 0) for y in _yrs} for n in _all}
    _avg = {n: np.mean(list(d.values())) for n, d in _dy.items()}
    _top = [n for n, _ in sorted(_avg.items(), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)[:10]]
    _hm = pd.DataFrame({n: [_dy[n][y] for y in _yrs] for n in _top}, index=_yrs).T
    _hm.index = [i.split(' ', 1)[1] if ' ' in i else i for i in _hm.index]
    sns.heatmap(_hm, annot=True, fmt='d', cmap='viridis', cbar_kws={'label': 'Degree'}, ax=axC, linewidths=0.5, annot_kws={'fontsize': 8})
    axC.set_xlabel('Year'); axC.set_ylabel('Comorbidity'); axC.set_title('Node degree, top central comorbidities'); axC.tick_params(axis='y', labelsize=8)
except Exception as e:
    axC.axis('off'); axC.text(0.5, 0.5, 'panel unavailable', ha='center', va='center', fontsize=8, transform=axC.transAxes)
_panel_label(axC, 'C')

try:
    _ly = centrality_df['Year'].max()
    _cd = (centrality_df[centrality_df['Year'] == _ly].sort_values('Degree_Centrality', ascending=True).tail(10))
    _names = [n.split(' ', 1)[1] if ' ' in n else n for n in _cd['Node']]
    _cols = [get_comorbidity_color(n) for n in _cd['Node']]
    axD.barh(range(len(_cd)), _cd['Degree_Centrality'].values, color=_cols, alpha=0.85, edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.4)
    axD.set_yticks(range(len(_cd))); axD.set_yticklabels(_names, fontsize=8)
    axD.set_xlabel('Degree centrality (0–1)'); axD.set_title(f'Most central comorbidities, {int(_ly)}'); axD.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3); sns.despine(ax=axD)
except Exception as e:
    axD.axis('off'); axD.text(0.5, 0.5, 'panel unavailable', ha='center', va='center', fontsize=8, transform=axD.transAxes)
_panel_label(axD, 'D')

try:
    _cm = community_metrics_df.sort_values('Year'); _yrs = _cm['Year'].astype(int).values
    axE.bar(_yrs, _cm['Num_Communities'].values, color='#56B4E9', alpha=0.75, width=0.6)
    axE.set_xlabel('Year'); axE.set_ylabel('Number of communities', color='#0072B2'); axE.tick_params(axis='y', labelcolor='#0072B2'); axE.set_xticks(list(_yrs))
    axE.set_ylim(0, max(3, int(_cm['Num_Communities'].max()) + 1))
    _e2 = axE.twinx(); _e2.plot(_yrs, _cm['Modularity'].values, 'o-', color='#009E73', linewidth=2.5, markersize=7)
    _e2.set_ylabel('Modularity Q', color='#009E73'); _e2.tick_params(axis='y', labelcolor='#009E73'); _e2.grid(False)
    axE.set_title('Louvain communities and modularity'); axE.grid(False)
except Exception as e:
    axE.axis('off'); axE.text(0.5, 0.5, 'panel unavailable', ha='center', va='center', fontsize=8, transform=axE.transAxes)
_panel_label(axE, 'E')

try:
    _kc = kcore_df.sort_values('Year'); _yrs = _kc['Year'].astype(int).values
    axF.plot(_yrs, _kc['Max_K'].values, 'o-', color='#CC79A7', linewidth=2.5, markersize=8, label='Maximum k-core')
    axF.plot(_yrs, _kc['Avg_K'].values, 's--', color='#009E73', linewidth=2.0, markersize=6, label='Average k-core')
    axF.set_xlabel('Year'); axF.set_ylabel('K-core level (k)'); axF.set_title('K-core decomposition over time'); axF.set_xticks(list(_yrs))
    axF.legend(fontsize=9, loc='best', framealpha=0.9); axF.grid(True, alpha=0.3); sns.despine(ax=axF)
except Exception as e:
    axF.axis('off'); axF.text(0.5, 0.5, 'panel unavailable', ha='center', va='center', fontsize=8, transform=axF.transAxes)
_panel_label(axF, 'F')

try:
    _gm = global_metrics_df.sort_values('Year'); _yrs = _gm['Year'].astype(int).values
    axG.bar(_yrs, _gm['Nodes'].values, color='#0072B2', alpha=0.75, width=0.6)
    axG.set_xlabel('Year'); axG.set_ylabel('Number of nodes', color='#0072B2'); axG.tick_params(axis='y', labelcolor='#0072B2'); axG.set_xticks(list(_yrs))
    _g2 = axG.twinx(); _g2.plot(_yrs, _gm['Edges'].values, 'o-', color='#D55E00', linewidth=2.5, markersize=7)
    _g2.set_ylabel('Number of edges', color='#D55E00'); _g2.tick_params(axis='y', labelcolor='#D55E00'); _g2.grid(False)
    axG.set_title('Network size over time'); axG.grid(False)
except Exception as e:
    axG.axis('off'); axG.text(0.5, 0.5, 'panel unavailable', ha='center', va='center', fontsize=8, transform=axG.transAxes)
_panel_label(axG, 'G')

fig.suptitle('Structure of comorbidity co-occurrence networks in endocrine hospitalizations, Chile GRD 2019–2024', fontsize=15, fontweight='bold', y=0.992)
try:
    plt.savefig(FIG_DIR / 'composite_network.png', dpi=1200, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor='white')
except Exception as e:
    pass
plt.show()
```

```{python}
# ---- Panel D: Strongest co-occurrence associations (average count) ----
axD = _axes[3]
try:

    def _plabel(p):

        _b = p[1].split(' ', 1)[1] if ' ' in p[1] else p[1]

    _names = [_plabel(p) for p, _ in _pairs]

# ---- Panel E: Associations with largest increase 2019->2024 ----
axE = _axes[4]
```
